title: α-glucose and β-glucose
caption: The two ring forms differ only in the –OH on carbon 1 (shaded): below the ring in α-glucose, above it in β-glucose. That one change decides whether glucose builds starch and glycogen (α) or cellulose (β).
alt: Ring structures of alpha-glucose and beta-glucose, each C6H12O6, with the carbon-1 hydroxyl group shaded.
description: α-glucose: the –OH on carbon 1 is below the ring.
β-glucose: the –OH on carbon 1 is above the ring.
Every other carbon is the same, so the two are stereoisomers that are not mirror images (diastereomers).
